title: In-product agents
claim: Add an assistant to the app you already run — no second service to operate.

page.tagline: Answer your users, act inside your product, hand off to a human.

scenarios.name: Answer, streamed into your UI
scenarios.text: agent.stream() on the server, the AI SDK message-stream route on the client, thread / resource memory so each user picks up where they left off.

scenarios.name: Act, through your own APIs
scenarios.text: Your endpoints become tools — plain objects with schemas — and multi-step flows compose as workflows where every boundary is validated.

scenarios.name: Hand off, with the run on hold
scenarios.text: Approval-listed tool calls never execute: the run suspends, and resume({ approved }) continues it — even from another process.
